meta.name: Apex Bee — EventStore streams + timeline stack

fields.name: transaction_id
fields.description: Transaction ID for this charge. Source TBD.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether POST /transaction/initialize succeeded. This is the API call, not whether the customer paid.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Paystack's message for the initialize call. The sample is "Authorization URL created".

fields.name: authorization_url
fields.description: Hosted checkout URL from data.authorization_url. The customer is sent here.

fields.name: access_code
fields.description: Checkout access code from data.access_code.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Transaction reference from data.reference. Later verify and webhooks use this.

fields.name: email
fields.description: User email from the Pay with Paystack Button. Paystack initialize requires the customer's email.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount to be paid in kobo, from the Pay with Paystack Button.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Paystack POST /transaction/initialize succeeded (true). This is the API call, not whether the customer paid.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Paystack message for a successful initialize. Sample: "Authorization URL created".

fields.name: data.authorization_url
fields.description: Hosted checkout URL from data.authorization_url. The customer is sent here.

fields.name: data.access_code
fields.description: Checkout access code from data.access_code.

fields.name: data.reference
fields.description: Transaction reference from data.reference. Later verify and webhooks use this. Populates SingleChargeInitiated.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Paystack request failed (false).

fields.name: message
fields.description: Brief description of the error. Examples: "Invalid Amount Sent", "Email Address is required", "Invalid key".

fields.name: type
fields.description: Error category from Paystack: api_error, validation_error, or processor_error.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Paystack-defined error code that categorizes the failure (e.g. missing_params).

fields.name: meta.nextStep
fields.description: Suggested action to resolve the issue from the error meta object.

nodes.name: Mark Customer Visit to Success Page
nodes.notes: Records that the customer visited the Paystack payment success page.

nodes.name: Mark Customer Visit to Cancel Page
nodes.notes: Records that the customer visited the Paystack payment cancel page.

nodes.name: Leave Group
nodes.notes: Command exists; no product UI wired yet (LeaveGroup)

fields.name: email
fields.description: The user's email for the person paying with this button. Paystack requires email.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The amount to be paid, in kobo.

nodes.name: Purchase License Page
nodes.notes: In-app payment page that hands the customer off to hosted Paystack checkout. Reconnects the Pay with Paystack Button path.

nodes.name: Paystack Checkout Page
nodes.notes: EXTERNAL — Hosted Paystack checkout outside the product. Customer pays here before returning to success or cancel.

nodes.name: Paystack Payment Success Page
nodes.notes: In-app success return after Paystack checkout; issues Mark Customer Visit to Success Page.

nodes.name: Paystack Payment Cancel Page
nodes.notes: In-app cancel return after Paystack checkout; issues Mark Customer Visit to Cancel Page.
